management_remarks: Q3 FY26 demonstrated sustained deal momentum for TCS with USD 10.6 billion in TCV wins and expanding client migrations across tier-1 global financial institutions. Enterprise clients increasingly bundled legacy modernization with proprietary TCS WisdomNext GenAI platforms, lifting average contract sizes and revenue visibility. Operating margins held firm at 24.8% alongside negative working capital intensity and Debtor Days improving to 65.8 days.
analyst_qa: In Q&A on seasonal furloughs and budget flushes, enterprise CIOs remained cautious in year-end spending, with discretionary transformation budgets moderating in retail and hi-tech. Competitive pricing in large vendor consolidation deals remains challenging and volatile, requiring calibrated delivery automation to protect margins. Timing of large deal revenue conversion remains subject to client transition readiness and uncertain macro headwinds.
